subject: register-role and stack-slot identity map for 0x007B6C30 admitted region (0x007B6C30-0x007B6C4A end-exclusive)
calling_convention: thiscall (MSVC x86 shape): this in ECX, one by-value DWORD stack argument, callee pops the argument (RET 0x4). Return value in EAX (NULL on fast path).

stack_map.layout: [ESP+0x00]=return address; [ESP+0x04]=stack arg 1 = KEY (caller: PUSH 0x00A85460 at P02 leaf-action callsites)
retaddr at [ESP+0x0C]; key at [ESP+0x10]  <-- consumed by CMP at 0x007b6c3d

POP EDI, POP EBP, POP EBX restore in reverse; XOR EAX,EAX (NULL); RET 0x4 pops return address then 4 bytes = the key argument. Fully balanced: 3 pushes + retaddr popped by RET, 1 arg DWORD popped by RET 0x4.

register_roles.role: on entry: receiver/this (thiscall); immediately copied to EBP at 0x007b6c33
repurposed as THIS after caller's EBP saved at 0x007b6c31; used as base for [this+0x18] read
loaded M[this+0x18] then SUB 0x1 => EDI = M[this+0x18] - 1 (count-minus-one candidate, P03-C8); register-only, no memory store
zeroed (XOR EBX,EBX) = the null/zero constant for the key test
return value; XOR EAX,EAX sets NULL on the fast path; produced by continuation on the main path (out-of-region)
NOT touched in the admitted region (callee-saved by convention; the continuation is expected to save it itself - NOT verified in-region)
